seo.title: Did the Whitechapel murders end with a hidden 6th victim?
seo.description:
The video examines whether a 25‑year‑old Spitalfields resident was the final, hidden victim of the Whitechapel murders. It also reviews Metropolitan Police files, confirming Mary Jane Kelly’s death at 13 Miller’s Court and the 1888 records in The National Archives.

#jacktheripper #whitechapel #truecrime #historymystery #nationalarchives

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Jane_Kelly
- https://thejacktherippertour.com/casebook/victims/mary-jane-kelly
- https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/explore-the-collection/stories/hoax-letter-signed-by-jack-the-ripper
